description: Compute a business/SaaS/finance metric with exact decimal precision. Metrics: ltv, cac, ltv_cac_ratio, payback_period_months, contribution_margin, gross_margin, churn_rate, mrr_growth_rate, arr, break_even_units, nrr, grr, rule_of_40, magic_number. Rates/margins are decimals (0.05=5%). Call list_metrics for schemas.
name: calculate_metric
